customer_id.meaning: primary id of the customer profile (seed uuid or content hash)

full_name.meaning: the customer's full name as printed on the profile; for a business profile, the name of the authorized contact person

phone_number.meaning: primary phone number on the profile; the number store counters use to pull up a customer

email.meaning: email address on the profile, lower case

billing_zip_code.meaning: ZIP code of the billing address on the profile

date_of_birth.meaning: date of birth of the individual customer or of the business's authorized contact

profile_opened_date.meaning: date the customer profile was first created at any Crestline store

customer_type.meaning: whether the profile belongs to a private individual or to a business customer (fleet buyer)

business_name.meaning: registered business name for a business profile; empty string for an individual

store_id.meaning: the customer's home store, the store where the profile was opened (foreign key -> stores)
primary id of the store record

store_number.meaning: Crestline store number printed on every ticket and invoice

store_name.meaning: display name of the store (e.g. Crestline Tire & Auto Care - Westerville)

city.meaning: city where the store is located

state.meaning: two-letter US state code of the store location

region.meaning: Crestline operating region the store belongs to

service_bays.meaning: number of service bays in the store, which bounds the appointment slots it can offer at the same time

vehicle_id.meaning: primary id of the vehicle record

customer_id.meaning: customer the vehicle is registered to on Crestline records (foreign key -> customers); for a fleet unit, the business profile

vehicle_class.meaning: fitment class of the vehicle used to select tire, brake and battery applications

usage_class.meaning: how the vehicle is used as declared on the vehicle record: personal use, or commercial use (business delivery, livery, service fleet)

license_plate.meaning: license plate as recorded at the last visit, upper case without spaces

tpms_type.meaning: tire pressure monitoring system fitted to the vehicle: direct (wheel-mounted sensors that need a service kit at each tire change), indirect (ABS-based), or none

tire_set_id.meaning: primary id of the tire set holding (one purchase of tires for one vehicle and its treadwear limited warranty)

customer_id.meaning: customer who bought the tires (foreign key -> customers)

vehicle_id.meaning: vehicle the tires were sold for and mounted on (foreign key -> vehicles)

store_id.meaning: store that sold and installed the set (foreign key -> stores)

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the tire set (basis defined in the tires charter lifecycle)

purchase_date.meaning: date of the sales ticket on which the tires were bought; the warranty term in months runs from this date

install_date.meaning: date the set was mounted on the vehicle; empty while still ordered

install_odometer.meaning: vehicle odometer reading recorded on the installation work order; miles driven on the set are measured from it; 0 while still ordered

tire_count.meaning: number of tires on the ticket, including a matching full-size spare where sold

tire_size.format: ISO metric size string (e.g. 235/65R17 or LT265/70R17)

unit_price.meaning: selling price per tire on the original ticket, before installation charges, fees and tax

purchase_ticket_number.meaning: sales ticket number of the original purchase

payment_method.meaning: how the original ticket was paid

closed_date.meaning: date the set left active service (returned, cancelled, worn out or retired); empty while ordered or active

adjustment_credit_balance.meaning: treadwear adjustment credit issued on this set and not yet applied or expired; identically the sum of the adjustment_credit account deltas

tire_event_id.meaning: primary id of the tire event row

tire_set_id.meaning: tire set the event belongs to (foreign key -> tire_sets)

customer_id.meaning: owning customer (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, verbatim from the tires charter

event_date.meaning: date the event was recorded (for a booking, the date the appointment was made)

store_id.meaning: store where the event took place (foreign key -> stores); empty for system-booked rows such as credit expiry

odometer.meaning: vehicle odometer read off the dashboard on the work order; 0 where no vehicle was present

tire_position.meaning: wheel position the row concerns (left/right front/rear, full-size spare), or ALL for a whole-set service

appointment_date.meaning: date of the booked installation appointment; empty for other rows

appointment_time.meaning: start time of the booked appointment slot; empty for other rows

service_code.meaning: service performed or booked; none for rows that are not a bay service

min_tread_depth_32nds.meaning: lowest tread depth measured in any main groove of the tire at inspection; 0 for rows without a measurement

wear_pattern.meaning: wear pattern the technician recorded at inspection; none for rows without an inspection

defect_code.meaning: manufacturing defect identified for a workmanship replacement; none otherwise

current_selling_price.meaning: the store's selling price of the same tire on the date of a treadwear adjustment or workmanship replacement; 0.00 on other rows

miles_driven.meaning: odometer at adjustment minus the set's install_odometer; 0 on other rows

credit_pct.meaning: prorated adjustment percentage granted; 0 on other rows

amount.meaning: money amount of the row: credit issued, credit applied, credit expired or refund paid; 0.00 for service rows

charge_amount.meaning: amount charged to the customer for a bay service on this row (0.00 when included)

source_tire_event_id.meaning: the earlier tire event this row derives from: the inspection behind an adjustment or workmanship replacement, or the adjustment whose credit is applied or expires; empty otherwise

ticket_number.meaning: store ticket the money on this row moved on: the replacement purchase a credit was applied to, or the original purchase being refunded; empty otherwise

payment_method.meaning: tender a refund was returned to; none on rows that move no customer money

refund_reason.meaning: why a refund row was paid: a satisfaction-trial return or an order cancellation; none on other rows

tire_return_request_id.meaning: primary id of the satisfaction-trial return request

customer_id.meaning: customer asking to return the set (foreign key -> customers)

tire_set_id.meaning: tire set to be returned (foreign key -> tire_sets)

request_type.meaning: whether the customer asks for the money back or for a different tire line

odometer.meaning: odometer reading the customer reports at the time of the request

request_status.meaning: status of the request: registered by the agent and awaiting the customer's confirmation, confirmed by the customer, or withdrawn

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
